answer: For 2025, total Scope 1 including operational-control companies was 2.7 MtCO2e, total market-based Scope 2 on the same basis was 0.9 MtCO2e, and total Scope 3 was 883.74 MtCO2e. Their sum is 887.34 MtCO2e, which rounds to the separately disclosed market-based total GHG emissions of 887.4 MtCO2e; the apparent 0.06 Mt difference is explained by one-decimal disclosure rounding.
